metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from Fujifilm, FUJICOLOR REALA 500D (35 mm Type 8592), ECN-2, Status M. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its colour, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts with the donor's dye spectra and the base density of the agx reference profile 'kodak_vision3_250d'. Mid-grey 1.05 decades above the green layer's D-min + 0.1 speed point (log H -2.032 on the sheet's axis). The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. Dye spectra, base density, Hanatos-2025 adaptation parameters, DIR couplers inherited from 'kodak_vision3_250d', which shares this stock's dye set and process.
